tickets.title: Recover client account access
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client cannot access an approved account vault, custodian site, or secure document vault. Confirm identity, determine whether the issue is username, password, device, multi-factor authentication, locked account, or outdated contact information, and document the resolution path before closing the request. For Lena Copperwisp, restore individual access to the shared document vault. Authentication codes are still routing to Marcus Copperwisp’s mobile number, preventing Lena from retrieving estate and account records.

subTasks.title: Verify identity and access scope
subTasks.text: Confirm the requester through approved identity verification steps and identify which portal, custodian, or document vault is affected. Do not reset credentials until the verification notes are complete.

subTasks.title: Diagnose recovery path
subTasks.text: Determine whether the client needs a username reminder, password reset, MFA troubleshooting, profile contact update, device guidance, or custodian support escalation.

subTasks.title: Coordinate custodian or platform escalation
subTasks.text: If the issue cannot be resolved internally, prepare the escalation summary with verification status, affected access point, error description, and any required client authorization.

subTasks.title: Confirm restoration and record outcome
subTasks.text: Confirm the client can sign in successfully, remind the client not to share credentials, and record the final resolution in the client record.

tickets.evidence: She asked Apricot Compass Advisory to restore her individual access through verified channels, and the agreed follow-up is due 2023-10-06.

tickets.title: Review beneficiary update request
tickets.text:
Review criteria:
- Confirm which accounts, policies, plans, or registration types require beneficiary review.
- Compare current beneficiary records against the client’s stated intent and estate planning notes.
- Verify full legal names, relationships, percentage allocations, contingent beneficiaries, and per stirpes or per capita elections where applicable.
- Confirm allocations total correctly and do not conflict with account or custodian rules.
- Identify whether spouse consent, trustee information, minor beneficiary handling, or legal review is needed.

Evidence to collect:
- Current custodian or plan beneficiary record
- Client authorization or signed beneficiary form
- Relevant trust name and trustee details, if a trust is named
- Estate planning summary or attorney instruction, if available
- Confirmation notice or screenshot after processing

Document any discrepancy, missing signature, or follow-up required before marking the update complete. Marcus remains listed as primary beneficiary, while the estate summary describes the children and trust provisions as the next intended backstop.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position
tickets.text:
Complete the following checks:
- Identify the position, account location, cost basis, holding period, and percentage of total investable assets.
- Confirm whether the holding is employer stock, inherited stock, restricted equity, a legacy position, or a tax-sensitive lot.
- Review unrealized gain or loss, dividend exposure, liquidity needs, and any trading restrictions or blackout windows.
- Evaluate tax-aware diversification options, including staged sales, gifting, charitable strategies, exchange funds if appropriate, or hedging considerations.
- Compare concentration risk against the client’s financial plan, retirement income needs, and risk tolerance.
- Document recommended next steps, required approvals, and any CPA or legal coordination needed before transactions.
